text:
Maya (customer): Hey team — our $200 trial credits landed in an old org we stopped using (org ID: org_0189-legacy). Our production workspace is org_9a7b and prod API key is returning billing/limit errors. We're blocked on a release. Can someone take a look?

jin-support: Sorry about that, Maya. Quick Qs: can you paste both full org IDs and the email that owns the legacy org? Also when did you sign up / redeem the trial?

Maya (customer): Legacy org: org_0189-legacy (owner m.lewis@acme.com). New prod org: org_9a7b (owner team@acme.com). Signed up 2026-02-28, got the "You've got $200 in trial credits" email that day. When calling our prod endpoint we see JSON: {"error":"usage_limit_exceeded","detail":"trial credits exhausted"}.

jin-support: Thanks — flagging to billing ops. Ava-billing, can you confirm where promo_2026_trial_200 landed and what options we have to reassign? Repro steps from customer: curl -H 'Authorization: Bearer <key>' https://api.redwood.ai/v1/usage  -> returns 402 / usage_limit_exceeded.

Ava-billing: @jin-support I can see promo_2026_trial_200 is attached to org_0189-legacy (redeemed via self-serve). Policy: we can transfer credits if the customer owns both orgs and requests transfer. Need confirmation of ownership and a short confirmation message from the admin email on file (m.lewis@acme.com).

Maya (customer): I confirm both orgs are under our control and m.lewis@acme.com is the admin for the legacy org. Please move credits to org_9a7b — we need this before EOD.

jin-support: Escalating: @Carlos (billing-ops) can you perform a manual reassignment and add an audit note (CS-12345)? Also paste the internal command you run so we have repro/trace.

Carlos (billing-ops): On it. I'll reassign promo_2026_trial_200 -> org_9a7b and create audit id credit_transfer_1769854321. ETA ~45m. Internal runbook: 1) validate ownership via admin email 2) run safe DB update with rollback guard 3) mirror change to billing ledger. Example SQL we run in staging-first then prod: `UPDATE grants SET org_id='org_9a7b', modified_by='carlos@redwood' WHERE id='promo_2026_trial_200' AND org_id='org_0189-legacy';`

jin-support: Thanks Carlos — please post confirmation once complete so I can verify and close with the customer.

billing-bot: Action completed: promo_2026_trial_200 reassigned to org_9a7b by Carlos at 2026-03-01T15:22:10Z. Audit ref: credit_transfer_1769854321.

Carlos (billing-ops): Done and verified via admin UI + usage API. I also noted in the audit: "moved per customer request; CS-12345".

Maya (customer): Confirmed — our API calls now succeed and usage shows remaining $199.50. Huge help, thank you! :tada:

jin-support: Great — closing CS-12345. FYI filing a small UX request (PRD-789) to show org selection on promo redemption to prevent future misattachments.

Ava-billing: Leaving a follow-up: we should add an automated check for recently deactivated orgs during promo assignment (ticket BILL-402).
